messages:
morgan: Heads up — I opened a docs PR to unify the quickstart credential docs for HelloKit. We had mixed env var names across samples (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812
sasha: Nice, I saw that. CI is failing because the docker sample still expects REDWOOD_API_KEY.
ben: can confirm. Error from sample run:
```
Error: missing env var REDWOOD_API_KEY
at startup.js:12:9
```
ben: Suggest we swap all examples to `REDWOOD_KEY` and add a short note saying it's the canonical var for CLI/SDKs.
taylor: I'll update the Dockerfile + k8s manifest in the PR. Quick patch:
```
# Dockerfile
ENV REDWOOD_KEY=""
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```
sasha: Also update the TypeScript snippet — SDK6/7 uses `client.auth.setKey(...)` in some examples; new SDK uses `new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })` — we should prefer constructor option.
morgan: Good catch. ben can you drop a one-liner patch for the TS snippet?
ben: on it. Proposed change:
```
// old
const client = new Client();
client.setKey(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY);
// new
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
```
docs-bot: PR checks: lint failed on docs/hello/sample-app.md: line 42 (code fence language missing)
docs-bot: CI rerun queued by @taylor
sasha: I'll handle the code fence and add a small note in the troubleshooting section about migrating env var names.
morgan: Plan: update snippets (TS + Py), Dockerfile, k8s, and a short CHANGES note. After fixes, re-run CI and merge. @ben @taylor @sasha thanks :rocket: 
ben: quick question — do we need a migration guide for existing users? or a small note in the release notes is enough?
sasha: release notes + a one-paragraph "If you rely on REDWOOD_API_KEY..." in the quickstart should be enough.
morgan: Agreed. Let's aim to get this merged today. I'll assign follow-ups in the PR.
taylor: pushing Dockerfile fix now.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #812 — all green :white_check_mark:
morgan: awesome, merging in 10 if no objections :shipit:
ben: :+1:
sasha: :thumbsup:
